answer_1.quote: We conduct comprehensive experiments on four tasks, question generation, commonsense generation, text summarization and machine translation.
answer_1.outputs: generated text sequences such as questions, commonsense sentences, summaries and translations

answer_2.quote: We measure the generated outputs from multiple aspects including text quality, relevance, diversity ... We adopted two relevance based metrics, ROUGE (R1, R2, RL) and METEOR (MTR), and we measure naturalness with MAUVE. For MT we report BLEU and COMET‑QE. Diversity is measured by Distinct‑1.
